messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High 95th percentile generation latency detected in us-west-2. Trigger: 5xx spike + request queue growth. Paging @sara_oncall
sara_oncall: Ack. Jumping in. Opening this thread for ops -> will coordinate statuspage + customer comms
jamie_sre: I see KV-cache miss rate up ~30% vs baseline after last canary. Memory pressure likely. Investigating process lists + GC.
sara_oncall: Need initial statuspage copy within 10m. @leo_prodcomms can you draft? Also looping @maria_custops for customer notes.
leo_prodcomms: On it. Proposed initial copy:
```
We are investigating increased generation latency for customers in US-West. Some requests may experience delays or intermittent errors. Impact: degraded response times for text generation and streaming. Mitigation: rolling back a recent canary and adding capacity. Time: approximately 14:08 UTC. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.
```
maria_custops: Can we add a note about potential transient 502/timeout for embedding endpoints? A couple of customers reported retries.
leo_prodcomms: Good catch — added a line about transient errors and recommended client retry/backoff.
oliver_legal: Avoid the word "outage". Language looks fine otherwise.
sara_oncall: Taking mitigation actions: rolling back canary now -> dev-deploy-bot: rollback request issued
dev-deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for release gen-canary rev=abc123 by sara_oncall. Estimated completion ~2m.
jamie_sre: Rollback finished, canary removed. Queues are draining, seen immediate drop in 95th latency.
leo_prodcomms: Updated statuspage draft to mention rollback + mitigation. Preparing to publish; requesting quick approvals :eyes:
maria_custops: LGTM from customer ops. Added line: "No data loss expected; if you see persistent failures please open a support ticket."
oliver_legal: Approved for publish.
leo_prodcomms: Published initial status update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/abcd1234 :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Statuspage update published by leo_prodcomms at 1759100045
sara_oncall: Monitoring metrics. Tail latency trending down but still above SLO. Will send 15m update.
jamie_sre: Root cause appears to be a memory regression introduced by nightly quantization job. Fix queued; will deploy a hotfix after we confirm stability.
leo_prodcomms: Drafting 15-minute update:
```
Update (approx +15m): We rolled back a recent canary and added capacity. Tail latency improved and queue sizes are decreasing. Some customers may still see intermittent errors; retries recommended. Engineers are working on a patch to remove the regression. Next update in 15m or when we have a timeline for the patch.
```
sara_oncall: +1 post that now.
leo_prodcomms: 15m update posted.
jamie_sre: Hotfix built and deployed to canary-successor; observing metrics returning to baseline.
sara_oncall: Metrics normalized. Confirming no active queues and error rates back to normal.
jamie_sre: Root cause remediation: revert memory-heavy allocation in quantization job. Patch rolled into prod, validated.
leo_prodcomms: Drafting resolved notice:
```
Resolved: The generation latency issue has been resolved. The problematic canary was rolled back and a hotfix was deployed to address a memory regression. Impact: transient latency spikes and intermittent errors in US-West. No customer data loss identified. If you continue to see issues, please contact support.
```
sara_oncall: Publishing resolved now.
leo_prodcomms: Resolved update posted to statuspage: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/abcd1234/resolved :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved and statuspage updated to "resolved" at 1759100120
sara_oncall: Thanks team. I'll file the post-incident note and assign follow-ups for a deeper root cause analysis and test coverage for quantization jobs.
jamie_sre: Adding RCA notes in the incident doc. Closing this thread.
